notes: S3.1 incorrectly counts the request-acceptance edge as the first timeout service edge and therefore loads TIMEOUT_CYCLES-1 rather than TIMEOUT_CYCLES. The frozen timing defines the allowed acknowledgement window as edges N+1 through N+TIMEOUT_CYCLES after a request accepted at edge N. The mutated countdown therefore times out one service edge too early. S2.2 had already stated the correct TIMEOUT_CYCLES load, making S3.1 the earliest substantive error. The final RTL reproduces the early-timeout behavior, and trusted simulation fails O_TIMEOUT_EXACT, O_ACK_PRIORITY, and O_BUSY_REQUEST_IGNORED while bounded formal verification also finds a counterexample.
